description: This file defines the KeyboardInputManager class, handling keyboard and touch input events for a game, including key mappings, event listeners, and input handling logic.

classes.name: KeyboardInputManager
classes.description: Handles keyboard and touch input events for game control, including key mappings, swipe detection, and button interactions.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific event.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Triggers all callbacks associated with a specific event.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for keyboard, button, and touch events.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Emits a restart event to restart the game.

methods.name: keepPlaying
methods.description: Emits an event to keep the game going.

methods.name: bindButtonPress
methods.description: Binds click and touchend events to specified buttons.
